notes: The artifact is the user-designed Woodpecker CI and operations prototype, not the SpecNav starter canvas.
The shell contains Woodpecker branding, grouped sidebar navigation, global search, theme control, user controls and route-level business surfaces.

loading.reason: The declared UI artifact loads local fixtures synchronously and does not simulate an asynchronous loading delay. Running deployment and pipeline states were verified separately and are not treated as loading evidence.

empty.evidence: Desktop route audit recorded explicit empty-state regions on registered states 42 and 48.

error.evidence: Failed pipeline, error-analysis, alert, and failure-status surfaces rendered without browser errors.

disabled.evidence: Disabled controls were present on seven registered desktop states, including unavailable pipeline actions and read-only Forge fields.

permission.evidence: CLI authorization, administrator, protected-environment, approval, and secret-permission surfaces were directly rendered.

populated.evidence: All 67 registered routes and tab states rendered non-empty content at desktop and mobile viewports.
